fact: A survey of 138 Somali government employees finds 70.3% report having attended ICT or digital-skills training, and 55.1% report an ICT training programme or coordinator in their ministry.
The Ministry of Communications and Technology inaugurated a website development and design training for employees of the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs.

The National Communications Authority launched a cybersecurity certification training programme (CompTIA Security+, CISM, CISSP and others) for ICT staff nominated by government institutions, run 28 March to 8 May 2026 with World Bank SCALED-UP support and AFRALTI.

The National Institute of Telecommunications and Technology of the Ministry of Communications and Technology launched a programme to raise government employees' digital knowledge, opening with a data protection workshop.
